maml:description.maml:para: Creates a new logging context.
The `New-SerilogLogContext` cmdlet creates a new logging context and returns the context so that the caller can dispose it when no longer needed.

You can pipe the name of the property.
You can pipe the value of the property.
Returns a handle that removes the property from the log context when disposed.

maml:alert.maml:para: Call `Dispose` on the returned `IDisposable` to remove the property from the log context. Use a `try`/`finally` block to ensure the context is always cleaned up.

command:example.maml:title: --------- Example 1: Create a logging context for the EventId property and dispose it when no longer needed ---------

maml:introduction.maml:para: ```powershell PS> $context = New-SerilogLogContext -Name EventId -Value 42 PS> try { $logger.Information('Hello World!') } finally { $context.Dispose() } ```
